app.title: Rhythm Hero
home.tagline: Learn rhythm by clapping or tapping on the table
mic.title: Microphone tester
mic.intro: Clap or tap the table. First you hear one bar of claves; then the app goes quiet and you keep the pulse you see on screen.
mic.privacy: Sound is analysed only on this device: it is never recorded or sent.
mic.status.ready: Ready. Clap once to try it.
mic.offset.early: On average you are {ms} ms early.
mic.offset.late: On average you are {ms} ms late.
mic.offset.none: No claps were detected in time.
mic.error.denied: There is no permission to use the microphone. Allow it in your browser settings and try again.
mic.error.unavailable: No microphone was found, or another app is using it.
mic.error.unsupported: This browser cannot use the microphone. Try an up-to-date Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
notation.title: Sample notation
notation.intro: Every note and rest the game uses. Below, how each result is coloured.
notation.sample.basic: 4/4: whole, half, quarter and eighth notes
notation.sample.rests: 4/4: whole, half, quarter and eighth rests
notation.sample.dotted: 3/4: dotted half and dotted quarter notes
notation.sample.compound: 6/8: eighth notes, dotted quarter and rests
notation.legend: Green: perfect · Orange: early or late · Red: miss
play.title: Read and play
play.intro: Read the score and play each note when it reaches the yellow line. First you hear one bar of claves; then the app goes quiet and you follow the pulse light.
play.status.play: Your turn! Play when each note reaches the line.
summary.title: Result
cal.title: Calibration
cal.intro: This lets the game know how long your device takes to hear each clap. You hear one bar of claves; then clap 8 times following the light, just like in the game.
cal.current: Delay saved on this device: {ms} ms.
cal.none: This device has not been calibrated yet.
cal.ok: Done: your delay is {ms} ms. Saved on this device.
cal.notSaved: Done: your delay is {ms} ms. The browser won't let us save it, so it only lasts until you close the page.
cal.error.few: Not enough claps were heard. Move closer to the microphone and try again.
cal.error.spread: The claps were very uneven. Try again, calmly following the light.
cal.error.range: The result isn't reliable. Please calibrate again.
play.uncalibrated: This device has not been calibrated yet. Calibrating makes scoring fairer.
levels.title: Levels
levels.intro: Pass each level with at least 70 % to unlock the next one.
play.locked: This level is still locked. Pass the previous one to open it.
